description: A muscular barefoot man in a ragged loincloth raises a spear overhead in one hand and grips a long wooden-handled tool in the other, standing in muddy, salt-crusted ground. Several other men dig or hold spears in the midground, with thatched huts, palm trees, smoke and a distant fire behind them. The style is a dark, painterly oil look with no visible text, frame or border.
